reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly records that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, and §§ 7.1/8.3 impose no benchmarking or match-third-party-offer duty on Customer.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is the correct treatment for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.
Rationale is accurate as to the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer) and correctly notes that any Vendor-granted MFN would be welcome rather than flagged.
